Australian Lawmaker Critically Injured in Vehicle Attack; Man Charged

An Australian lawmaker is in critical condition after being rammed twice by a vehicle in what police are investigating as a targeted attack. The lawmaker sustained severe injuries, including the loss of a leg. A man has been charged in connection with the incident, and anti-terrorism police are among the agencies probing the motive. A witness reported that the alleged attacker had a knife.
